name: Gadrin's Parchment
summary: Gadrin's Parchment is read at Shadra'Alor in the Hinterlands. Its words summon Shadra, whose venom Apothecary Lydon seeks in Tarren Mill.

sections.title: At Shadra'Alor
sections.body: Deep in the Witherbark realm, Gadrin's Parchment is read at the altar of Shadra'Alor. Its words summon Shadra, the spider god. Her venom is sought by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill.

faq.answer: Gadrin's Parchment is read at Shadra'Alor to summon Shadra, the spider god.

faq.q: Where do I read the parchment?
faq.answer: Read Gadrin's Parchment at the altar of Shadra'Alor, deep in the Witherbark realm of the Hinterlands.
Shadra is the spider god summoned by reading Gadrin's Parchment at Shadra'Alor.
Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill seeks Shadra's venom.
